entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of weeks ago. It's a pair of your cycling shoes. I'd like to see what my options are for a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Got it, thank you. I see the Aero Road cycling shoes, delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's more of a fit issue. I've worn them around the house for a bit, but they're just not comfortable and I can already feel hot spots that I know will turn into blisters on a long ride. I haven't even mounted the cleats.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial for a good ride. Just to confirm, you're looking to get a full refund for them?

Yes, a refund would be ideal. I know I'm a little outside the usual 10 or 14-day window some places have. If a full return isn't possible, would you consider a partial store credit? I'm happy to buy another pair from you if we can find a model that works better.

I appreciate you asking, but there's no need to negotiate for credit. Let me just pull up our policy... okay. According to our system, VeloFit has a 90-day return window for standard items like these cycling shoes.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. I must have misremembered.
No problem at all. Since you received them 18 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Wow, that's fantastic news. Thank you, Charlie. I appreciate how easy you've made this.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks again for your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
